senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (अर्ब्बति)
1 To go, to go to towards.
2 To kill or hurt. See अर्व्व.

mn. (-दः-दं)
1 Ophthalmia.
2 A hundred millions.
m. (-दः)
1 The name of a mountain in the west of India, commonly Abū, a place of pilgrimage, especially to the Jains.
2 An indolent swelling.
E.
अर्ब to injure, उदच् affix; the root and derivative are also written with the dental letter.
